tagline: A Git-backed CMS for static Astro websites
description: Mica adds structured editing and a live preview to Astro. Content stays as JSON and Markdoc in Git, Astro builds static pages, and nothing needs a database.

announcement.text: Mica 0.15.0: an entry has an ID, and its page has a URL

status.label: experimental
status.bannerText: Mica is experimental and not ready for production. The API and the content format can still change, so read the release notes before you upgrade.
